On Thu, Aug 18, 2022 at 10:01 AM Johnny Walsh <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Vera will be the overall lead on this effort, and DRG will pony up a few others to help staff the Working Group. It would
be wonderful if DDI could identify an additional person or two who might want to contribute to the latter - ITR would
have obvious areas of overlap, or perhaps someone from PSE might want to help work on disinfo-related outreach to
tech companies, or someone from the Education hub might be interested in discussions this group would likely have on
digital/media literacy and education, as examples off the top of my head.
On Thu, Aug 18, 2022 at 9:27 AM Karl Fickenscher <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Johnny
Further to Vera's message below, who are you thinking of as the senior POC for DRG, and would that be the
same or an additional person for the rest of DDI? Would Vera be the POC for the former, or you, Ro or someone
else?
